detail.source:
stat: .stat

spectra:
    values: [[0.0: 257]: 4]
    detector: 0
    detector < 4?>
        sample: 0
        sample < 257?>
            energy: -1.0 + 0.0078125 * sample
            values.(detector, sample): 1.0 + (1.0 + detector) / (1.0 + 100.0 * energy ^ 2)
            .sample: sample + 1
        .detector: detector + 1
    values

contrasts: stat.ptp(spectra, 1)
selected_site:
    best: 0
    candidate: 1
    candidate < contrasts.length()?>
        contrasts.(candidate) > contrasts.(best)?
            .best: candidate
        .candidate: candidate + 1
    best

:: contrasts
:: selected_site

curve_energy: -1.0 + 0.00390625 * [0..512]
selected: 1.0 + (1.0 + selected_site) / (1.0 + 100.0 * curve_energy ^ 2)

:: selected.(256)

view: .ui.viewport
view.add(x: curve_energy_u, y: selected_u, color: [0.25, 0.72, 1, 1])
view.push(x_lim: [-1, 1], y_lim: [0, 6])
view.show()
